text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Haah— Yaaaaaaahhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Red Desire was making her final 
preparations for the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she can seize total victory in the 
Japan Cup, where the absolute strongest 
Umamusume gather—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Having reached a state where she could be 
said to have tamed the 'Crimson Wedge', 
she set her sights across the ocean, on 
her dream—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Victory at the BC is now well within 
reach.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Looked at another way...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I can't even stand a chance in this 
Japan Cup, then making a mark on the world 
is nothing but a pipe dream.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking on the BC. Acclaim from around the 
world. And the dream of reaching another 
world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We must not let our dearest wishes end as 
mere fairy tales.
choice_data_list:
(Still, with how Desire is now, she'll be 
fine.)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
—...Yes, without fail. I will reach it. 
That "place" I have longed for all this 
time.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Beyond conquering the Japan Cup—...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Red Desire is steadily maturing, both as a 
saint... and as a single racehorse 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To the point where I can believe there is 
nothing the current Red Desire cannot 
accomplish—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And finally, the day of the Japan Cup 
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tokyo Racecourse was swept up in an 
unprecedented frenzy as champions defining 
an era competed against one another.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yet, at the center of the clamor—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Only the area surrounding Red Desire is 
filled with a curiously sacred silence.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Ah... I can hear it.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Countless heartbeats shaking this earth, 
and... a voice from another world, 
beckoning me."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Having passed through countless eons, we 
have finally arrived at this moment, 
haven't we?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Now, as a saint, I must show proper 
courtesy to those who share this final 
trial with me.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...What an insane aura. She looks ready 
to swallow the Goddess of Victory whole."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama-san. This time, I will stake this 
very soul... everything I have into this 
challenge.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Because here... there is something I must 
obtain no matter what."

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The same goes for me. No matter how 
razor-sharp you hone yourself, I will not 
flinch.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Everyone gathered here is 
striving to fulfill their wishes.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
To run a race with no regrets, and make 
the dream come true.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I've made meticulous adjustments time and 
time again just for this day.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"I, too, shall come at you with all my 
heart to defeat you. —Prepare yourself."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: That cherished wish, that burning passion—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
A craving so intense it could consume 
one's entire being.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"That will be the light that guides the 
Holy Maiden, Red Desire, to 'that promised 
land.'"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Desire-chan. No matter how high you soar, 
I will never lose sight of you.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
We're comrades running on the same turf, 
after all. ...Today, I will take you to 
see that "breathtaking view."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I'm not gonna lose!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Yes... Buena-san.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"I will be waiting. Beyond that supreme 
brilliance, where no one else can reach."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Having finished greeting her rivals, the 
Saint gazes upon the path leading to the 
turf with eyes full of compassion."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: At the end of this road.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
There is a place we have continuously 
sought.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
It was the story of a saint who began her 
journey all alone... yet over time, it 
became beautifully adorned with countless 
bonds.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Vodka-san, who has always shown me the 
path to a whole new world.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Cafe-san, who understood me deeply and 
reached out a saving hand to me, as well 
as her 'friend.'"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Buena-san, who shared a once-in-a-lifetime 
ordeal with me.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
All the Umamusume who ran upon the turf 
together.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Everyone in this world who watched over 
all of it... and believed in me—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: And...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Your devotion—never once letting go of my 
hand, no matter what happened.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Right now, every single one of those 
blessings is transforming into a heat 
source driving my body forward.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: My companion... must be you and no other.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Now, Trainer-san... Let us walk together 
once again today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I gently take her outstretched hand.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whooosh...!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her hand was burning with heat.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In it lay a strength honed by fighting 
through countless trials, and a passion 
intense enough to burn everything to ash.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Through this hand, you shall see it too.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
The door to the alternate world is now... 
looming right before our eyes.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: —The time is ripe.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: The true awakening of Saint Red Desire...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Let the praises of all my devotees become 
my wings.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Manifest a miracle that bends even fate to 
its knees—!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Come, let us arrive! At that magnificent 
'Other World'—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The applause illuminates her like a halo.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The Saint has now taken a magnificent 
first step to etch her name into legend—"
